node: Power generation, grid interconnection, transmission services, nuclear fuel/enrichment, reactor components, and AI data-center power procurement
summary: Combined focused Layer 1B searches: Layer 1B expansion identifies direct public-market exposure around AI data-center power procurement and nuclear/grid bottlenecks. The clearest direct asset-owner signals are Constellation and Talen, where hyperscaler nuclear PPAs connect AI/cloud load to specific nuclear assets. The underfollowed discovery lane is stronger in nuclear fuel-cycle and component suppliers, especially Centrus and BWX Technologies, where AI demand is not always the primary market narrative but could become a second-order chokepoint if nuclear restart, SMR, and advanced-reactor procurement accelerate. This is research support only, not a buy/sell recommendation. Layer 1B expansion found a compact US-listed universe around the AI power chokepoint. The strongest underfollowed lane is not the hyperscaler or mega-cap utility layer, but medium-voltage switchgear, electrical construction, data-center electrical systems, and nuclear fuel-cycle capacity. Powell Industries, IES Holdings, and MYR Group map to power equipment and grid/data-center construction constraints; Centrus maps to the scarce HALEU/enrichment bottleneck needed for advanced nuclear reactors that hyperscalers increasingly reference as long-duration AI power supply. Claims are research leads only, not trading recommendations. Layer 1B expansion for the AI power/grid/nuclear-fuel node found one reference anchor with direct hyperscaler nuclear-data-center monetization and three underfollowed or speculative discovery names tied to electrical distribution equipment, transmission/data-center electrical construction, and potential HALEU/nuclear
